metadata.changelog:
SmartClean 1.0.3 — optional per-slot countdown text, now drawn above the item icons.

- New `trash.showSlotTimers` (default false): turn it on to show each slot's remaining retention time in the top-left corner; off by default so icons stay unobstructed.
- The countdown is really above the icons now. Item icons live in a separate item buffer that flushed after the batched text; Forge/NeoForge 1.20.1-1.21.1 first flush the base layer and item buffer, then draw the text on an explicit z=250 layer with an in-block flush; 26.x's GuiGraphicsExtractor has no Z axis and opens a new stratum instead.
- Text colour is opaque white 0xFFFFFFFF (26.x text colours are full ARGB and six-digit values render invisible).
- Everything from 1.0.2 is included: the Shift-click fix, real paging, side page arrows JEI cannot cover, config in config/smartclean-common.toml with trash.playerInsert, and the NeoForge 26.2 build.

---
SmartClean 1.0.3：槽位剩余时间改为可选开关，并且真正画在物品图标之上。

- 新增 `trash.showSlotTimers`（默认 false）：打开后每个格子左上角显示该物品的剩余保留时间；默认关闭，物品图标不被文字压住。
- 倒计时现在真的在图标上层。物品图标走独立的 item buffer，晚于批处理文字落屏；1.20.1～1.21.1 改成先冲刷基础层与物品、再在 z=250 的显式层画字并在块内 flush；26.1.2/26.2 的 GuiGraphicsExtractor 没有 z 轴，改用 nextStratum 另起一层。
- 文字颜色为不透明白色 0xFFFFFFFF（26.x 的文字颜色是完整 ARGB，六位色值会完全透明）。
- 包含 1.0.2 的全部改动：Shift 点击修复、真正分页、JEI 不会覆盖的翻页箭头、config/smartclean-common.toml 中的配置与 trash.playerInsert、NeoForge 26.2 构建。
